deadline.quote: Microbiology M.S., Ph.D. N/A CV, PS, 3 LoR, GRE (optional) 100/7.5 Fall: Jan. 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

toefl_min.value: The department says a TOEFL below 100 will reduce admission chances, so this is a benchmark rather than a hard cut-off.
toefl_min.quote: A TOEFL score below 100 or an IELTS score below 7.5 will reduce the chances of admission

also.quote: International applicants with a TOEFL score between 65 and 79 or an IELTS score of 5.5 or 6.0 may apply for conditional admission

ielts_min.value: The department says an IELTS below 7.5 will reduce admission chances. Scores of 5.5 or 6.0 can qualify for conditional admission.
ielts_min.quote: A TOEFL score below 100 or an IELTS score below 7.5 will reduce the chances of admission

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a sponsor is needed for standard admission. Conditional applicants need one.

funding.value: Most students receive university support, mostly as teaching assistants.
funding.quote: Most students receive University support in the form of teaching assistant

entry_route.value: Applicants from outside the US, Canada, Australia, New Zealand or Western Europe most likely hold a master's in biology or biochemistry.
entry_route.quote: Successful applicants with degrees from institutions located elsewhere in the world will most likely have completed a master’s degree

notes: Also covers the Cell, Molecular and Structural Biology PhD (CMSB), an interdepartmental program that is not saved as its own record because the field already has one. CMSB: deadline Jan. 1 and GRE optional per the Graduate School table, any CMSB faculty member may serve as advisor, funding and sponsor rules not stated.
